gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

gre_general.value: The GRE table on the page sits under the M.S. program's application deadlines, not the PhD, so no PhD GRE rule is stated.

deadline.value: Entry is each semester, with materials due six weeks before term begins; the catalog gives no date.

supervisor.value: Students meet prospective mentors in their first year and choose one by the end of that year, so admission does not depend on a named supervisor.
supervisor.quote: The process of selecting the graduate research mentor must be completed by the end of the student's first year.

funding.value: The chemistry page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: The page does not say whether a master's is needed before the PhD.

notes: Chemistry M.S. and Ph.D. on the same catalog page. The only application table sits in the M.S. section, so it is not used for the PhD. Rotations in the first year are described on the page.
